attack_plan.narrative: Unusual activity has been reported above the Kremlin in recent days, sparking speculation about a possible change in leadership. White smoke was observed on March 13th, leading some to suggest a new leader might be emerging. However, the Kremlin has countered with a new photo featuring what appears to be Vladimir Putin alongside U.S. President Obama, though critics remain skeptical. The absence of Putin since March 10th, combined with the absence of traditional Kremlin symbols, has raised questions about potential geopolitical maneuvers. The Kremlin continues to prepare for a military parade marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation, despite the ongoing uncertainty surrounding Putin’s status. Meanwhile, public speculation about Putin’s whereabouts has spiked, with some suggesting he may be involved in a secret project or even an international event.
